coverage_note: Seed database. Only records with traceable sources are included. Every record carries a verification_status and explicit flags. Records marked official-quoted or secondary still require a human verification pass against RTSS reports or the cited official post before being treated as confirmed. verification_policy: See docs/methodology.html and README.md. Unknown original rulings, dates, or game IDs are stored as null with a flag, never filled by assumption.
